worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the strategy function chooses the channel patterns the model will reach customers through, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-eo-conceive-verify-25d55c.plain_language_name: Check the Inputs Before Choosing the Channels

processes:task-eo-conceive-verify-25d55c.business_purpose: It exists so channels are never chosen from a strategy whose bounds were never stated.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds the journey designs missing a whole customer segment and flags the defect before channels are chosen.
